integrity: The primary source was checked at the definition of the weak inhomogeneous quasiregular class and at the local derivative estimate used in its main proof. The new conclusion follows from an exact one-variable optimization after normalizing by the maximal stretch, and every boundary coefficient pair is realized by an explicit affine harmonic map. The critical-point algebra was independently checked symbolically and reconstructed in the written proof.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies pointwise estimates that are linear in the derivative energy and the additive defect for planar weak harmonic quasiregular maps. It does not optimize nonlinear local expressions, global Hardy-space constants, or higher-dimensional analogues.
title: Exact energy–defect frontier for weak harmonic quasiregularity
